details.method: Before hashing evidence on Windows, compare worktree bytes with the Git index normalization and normalize task-owned text to LF, then obtain independent exact-byte review.
details.when: Repository formal gate compares raw worktree evidence bytes with staged Git bytes and Git applies CRLF normalization.
details.counterexample: Binary files, signed historical evidence, or files owned by other tasks must not be normalized.
details.trial_plan: In the next isolated Windows delivery, create task-owned UTF-8 CRLF evidence under text normalization, observe byte mismatch, normalize before hashing and stage, then verify the same gate passes without changing business code.
